results.rationale: Emailservice logs an AttributeError at 1731911689, proving its own-code fault. It is the only candidate with IVD initiator status (Copeland 1), indicating its anomaly is least explained by others and most explanatory for downstream symptoms. Downstream test confirms emailservice's failure causes checkoutservice's 'no healthy upstream' errors and frontend's error spike, with reverse call paths showing frontend->checkoutservice->emailservice. Shippingservice, though a source candidate, has no trace paths to main affected components and fails to explain symptoms; IVD labels it ambiguous. Checkoutservice is a clear victim with dependency-induced exceptions. Redis shows only reactive resource pressure. Frontend's late error spike is a propagated symptom. Thus emailservice is the root cause.
uncertainties: Exact trigger of AttributeError (code change, config, etc.) not identified, but not essential for RCA.
